races.display_title: SSP Signs & Graphics Handicap

races.verdict: TIME INTERVAL badly lost his way towards the end of last season but has become well handicapped on old form as a result and, having made a notable yard switch and undergone a second breathing operation, he's taken to revive. races.display_title: QuinnBet Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict: A 3-time winner in France, MARTIN'S DENUO made a better fist of things than he had on British debut when second in a small-field handicap chase at Fontwell 9 days ago. In receipt of a handy 4-y-o allowance, he shades preference back at this slightly shorter trip. Top weight Gaelic Rambler ought to be suited by the drop in distance and is feared, whilst Hudson is potentially well handicapped on the pick of his hurdles form. MARTIN'S DENUO (FR) GAELIC RAMBLER (IRE) HUDSON (FR)

races.verdict: SPEEDING BULLET dropped his biggest hint for a while that he's ready to strike from a much-reduced mark when runner up at Newcastle 12 days ago and could be worth chancing for all his high draw makes things tricky. Golden Havana has been given a break following a lesser run at Musselburgh and appeals as the type to bounce back. Albegone , Dc Cogent and Betweenthesticks are others to consider in a competitive finale. SPEEDING BULLET (IRE) GOLDEN HAVANA (IRE) ALBEGONE

races.verdict: STIPULATION won this race last year off a similar mark so could be worth chancing having shaped well at Chepstow last time. Ballybunion is a likely danger if seeing out this longer trip, while Have You A Minute is also shortlisted after his encouraging second at Southwell. STIPULATION (IRE) BALLYBUNION (IRE) HAVE YOU A MINUTE

races.verdict: SAXOPHONIC has unquestionably been a flop considering his pedigree and price tag, but left the impression a step up to 1¾m may prove beneficial at Ffos Las on his most recent outing and could be up to opening his account from a basement mark. races.verdict: MINELLA ROCKETT is thriving at present and is taken to extend his winning sequence to 4, perhaps at the expense of lightly-raced 4-y-o Queen of The Bogs , who shaped well on her reappearance at Fairyhouse in June. Puppet Master has opened his account over hurdles since last seen on the Flat, so it's reasonable to expect a better showing on return to this code. MINELLA ROCKETT (IRE) QUEEN OF THE BOGS (IRE) PUPPET MASTER (IRE)

races.verdict: BACK STRAIGHT made a promising start when splitting a pair of Aidan O'Brien's better 3-y-os here 12 months ago and is the obvious call fitted with a tongue tie in the hope all is well. Xirivella could be the danger, ahead of Fleur de Provence . BACK STRAIGHT XIRIVELLA (IRE) FLEUR DE PROVENCE (IRE)

races.display_title: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Fillies Handicap
races.verdict: SWEET BABY ZOU looks capable of adding to her sole success before the season is out judged on her last 2 performances under her young claimer and gets the vote in a tricky handicap. Galway winner Rest Your Mind , Lady Arwen and Areana are a trio of the other likely contenders. SWEET BABY ZOU REST YOUR MIND (IRE) LADY ARWEN
